title: A first week from Ho Chi Minh City
summary: Ho Chi Minh City, a Cu Chi day, Hoi An, and Da Nang.

days.title: Day 1 — The center
days.body: Land in Ho Chi Minh City and walk the center.

days.title: Day 3 — Cu Chi
days.body: Visit the Cu Chi tunnels. The site is 35,000 đồng and the guide is 100,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 4 — Fly to Da Nang
days.body: Fly to Da Nang. The flight is about 1 hour 20 minutes.

days.title: Day 5 — Hoi An
days.body: Walk the old town from the Japanese Covered Bridge.

days.title: Day 6 — Marble Mountains
days.body: See Marble Mountains. The adult ticket is 40,000 VND.

days.title: Day 7 — Leave Da Nang
days.body: Keep the morning on My Khe or in Hoi An and fly home.

seoTitle: Vietnam in 7 days from Ho Chi Minh City
seoDescription: Ho Chi Minh City, Cu Chi, Hoi An, and Da Nang in seven days.
